cohort: 60 pregnant mothers with clinically suspected IUGR.
finding: Of the 60 suspected IUGR cases, there were 9 intrauterine fetal deaths (6 with reversed umbilical artery diastolic flow and 3 with absent flow) and 51 live births with adverse outcomes including 7 low Apgar scores, 12 emergency c-sections, and 8 NICU admissions.
mod_finding: Emergency c-sections were performed in 12 out of 51 live births.
